scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix app install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix admin install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build:apps: npm --prefix app run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:apps && npm run serve
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix app test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix admin run typecheck
